title: Anaerobic digester prokaryotic community
description: Anaerobic digester sludge was sampled at kangbyun sewage treatment plant. We investigated the effect of peptone concentration on the anaerobic digester community. Prokaryotic communities were analysed using miseq sequencing.
center: Environmental Microbiology  Microbiology, Pusan National University
